# plugins

**Tier 0.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: _nothing above platform_.

Currently imports: _no other module_.

_Not a feature-map entry; it is shared by several features._

| `domain/` | 9 | 510 |
| `http/` | 4 | 497 |

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

- Kernel semver (`CORE_VERSION`) and plugin `version` / `engines.core` /
  `dependsOn` ranges are real: scan disables mismatches and enable returns
  `409 plugin_incompatible`. Required plugins cannot be turned off.
- Complements are off when a `dependsOn` parent is off
  (`isPluginEffectivelyEnabled`). Never import another plugin's `http/` or
  `infrastructure/`; use `getPluginService` or core `application/` APIs.
- `GET /admin/docs` loads `docs/` from every plugin folder, including
  docs-developer documenting itself. Disable a plugin and its docs group is
  marked disabled.
- Plugins must not ALTER kernel tables. Extra data is `plugin_<id>_…`
  created from that plugin's one `back/migrations/` baseline. Disable keeps those tables. Uninstall
  (`confirm: true`) runs `down`, drops leftovers, and deletes the
  `plugins` row. The host rejects migration SQL that mutates any other
  table. Kernel data is reached through owning-module `application/` APIs.
- Official updates read git **tags** (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, no `v`) on
  `by-tezov/tuucho-ecom` only, walk every intermediate tag, and never write
  `plugins/user/`. Kernel Apply writes `tuucho/kernel`, `tuucho/plugin-sdk`,
  `tuucho/factory-backup`, `tuucho/docs`, `tuucho/scripts`, `tuucho/sample`, the versioning
  catalog, and the shop root `package.json` so Core stays the published tag;
  `all` adds `tuucho/plugins`. Each scoped tree is replaced wholesale; a path
  outside the scope list is never written or removed, so root-level moves
  between tags need `git pull`. Plugins Core and Check current are live
  root `package.json`. Latest is the origin’s newest tag. Local ahead of
  that tag has no Apply. Last applied official tag is gitignored `tuucho-versioning.lock.json`
  (Apply cursor, not display). User plugins update only from npm
  `repository` on that plugin `package.json` (HTTPS GitHub). A private
  repository uses the fine-grained token in `github_repository_access` when
  that URL matches. No row means a public fetch. Dirty
  `plugins/` refuses Apply. Failure restores the snapshot.

<!-- invariants:end -->
